description: This file defines a RecipeProvider class responsible for managing recipe data, including loading, searching, and saving recipes. It interacts with external RecipeRepository and StorageService classes and acts as a state manager for a Flutter application.

classes.name: RecipeProvider
classes.description: A change notifier class managing recipes, including load, search, and save functionalities, used as a provider in Flutter applications.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads saved recipe IDs and fetches all recipes from the repository, initializing the provider state.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Updates the loading state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: toggleSaved
methods.description: Adds or removes a recipe ID from the saved set and persists the change.

methods.name: isSaved
methods.description: Checks if a recipe ID is in the saved set.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the search query with debounce and updates the visible recipes based on the search result.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels debounce timer and performs cleanup.
